module: Drives the vehicle's animated props (jbeam "props" section: needles, steering wheel, articulated parts, prop lights). Every frame, each prop reads the value electrics.values[prop.func], converts it (multiplier, min, max, offset) and sends it to the engine via obj:propUpdate. Also handles hiding props when a break group (breakGroup) or deform group (deformGroup) is broken.
usage:
-- manually hide the props of a break group
props.hidePropsInBreakGroup('door_FL')
notes: M.updateGFX is nop (empty function) as long as no prop exists; reset() replaces it with the real updateGFX function only if v.data.props contains at least one prop. If the props disappear after a reset, updateGFX stays on the old function (not set back to nop).
Value sent to the engine: clamp(val * multiplier, min, max) + offset; booleans are converted to 0/1. The prop is hidden if prop.hidden is true.

Prop light jbeam keys (lightScaling): brightnessMinInput (default 0), brightnessMaxInput (1), flareScaleMinInput (0.6), flareScaleMaxInput (1), lightColorOffsetRed (0), lightColorOffsetGreen (60), lightColorOffsetBlue (80). They are only used if the prop also defines lightBrightness, flareScale and lightColor.
breakGroup and deformGroup can be a string or a list of strings; empty strings are ignored.
A group is processed only once: after hidePropsInBreakGroup / disablePropsInDeformGroup, the table entry is removed until the next reset.

updateGFX.desc: nop by default; replaced by the props update during reset()/init() if the vehicle has props. ⚠ nop is defined elsewhere (game global).

init.desc: Identical to reset() (M.init = reset). Reads v.data.props, builds the breakGroup/deformGroup tables, normalizes the lightScaling config.

reset.desc: Resets the state of each prop (disabled=false, hidden=false, lastVal=math.huge), rebuilds the group indexes and enables updateGFX if there are props.

disablePropsInDeformGroup.desc: Disables and hides all props attached to the given deform group, then sets them back to 0 on the engine side. Called by damage handling (beamstate) when a group deforms.

hidePropsInBreakGroup.desc: Disables and hides all props attached to the given break group, then sets them back to 0 on the engine side. Called when a beam group breaks.
